payload.reason: The evidence discusses various stopping methods and their performance in active learning tasks, specifically mentioning the evaluation of batch sizes and their impact on learning efficiency and stopping criteria.

claims.text: The evaluation of stopping methods includes the Oracle Method and BV2009, which are assessed based on their performance in active learning tasks.
Different batch sizes (1%, 5%, and 10% of training data) are evaluated to determine their effect on the performance of active learning methods.
The performance metrics evaluated include F-Measure and the number of annotations required for stopping methods.
